k:杉.mnemonic: A tall straight tree (木) whose needles hang in neat combed lines like whiskers (彡), with a scent that fills the whole forest. Cedar (cryptomeria).

k:陣.mnemonic: Behind the mound (阝) the army's cars (車) are drawn up in ranks, wheels chocked and tents pitched between them, waiting for the order. Camp (battle array, ranks, position).
k:陣.hint: Army wagons ranked behind a mound.

k:儀.mnemonic: A leader (亻) known for righteousness (義) hears each matter brought before him with full ceremony, one affair at a time. 'Next, please.' Case (ceremony, rule, affair).
k:儀.hint: Just leader hearing matters one by one.

k:昼.mnemonic: The flag (尸) goes up the pole at dawn (旦) and flies until it is lowered at sunset. While the flag is up, it is the bright part of the day. Daytime (noon).

k:妙.mnemonic: A woman (女) of few (少) words and few gestures, each one so perfectly judged that the room goes quiet just to watch her pour tea. Exquisite (strange, mystery, miracle).

k:晩.mnemonic: After a decameron (旬), ten days of work without a break, the foreman finally gives the excuse (免) everyone wants: the sun is down, go home. Nightfall (night).

k:隆.mnemonic: A camel trudges (夂) over a mound (阝) carrying its life (生) supply of water in a bulge on its back: a mound riding over a mound. Hump (high, noble, prosperity).

k:覇.mnemonic: A warlord rides in from the west (西) in leather (革) armour, and within a month (月) every rival is kneeling. One power stands over all the rest. Hegemony (supremacy, leadership, champion).

k:哲.mnemonic: A thinker takes an idea in his fingers (扌), splits it with an axe (斤) to see what is inside, then opens his mouth (口) to ask: but why? Philosophy (clear).
k:哲.hint: Splitting an idea to look inside.

k:駆.mnemonic: A horse (馬) gallops through every ward (区) of the city, its rider pressing it on to carry the news before sundown. Drive (run, gallop, advance).
k:駆.hint: Rider galloping through the city wards.

k:乳.mnemonic: A child (子) reaches with a claw (爪) of a hand for the bottle, whose teat curves like a fishhook (乙), and will not let go until it is empty. Milk (breasts).

k:絡.mnemonic: A kitten takes the end (終) of a ball of wool in its mouth (口) and runs round the chair legs until everything is wound up together. Entwine (coil around, get caught in).
k:絡.hint: Kitten winding wool round chair legs.

k:拝.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) pressed together and raised before a shrine in a dry (干) land, asking the sky for rain. Worship (adore, pray to).
k:拝.hint: Hands pressed together, asking for rain.

k:姫.mnemonic: A woman (女) with a retainer (臣) walking one step behind her, carrying her parasol and bowing whenever she turns. Princess.

k:棄.mnemonic: A book (本) nobody wants and an empty cocoon (厶) are tossed into a pit (凵) at the edge of town and left there for good. Abandon (throw away, discard, reject).
k:棄.hint: Unwanted things tossed in a pit.

k:氷.mnemonic: Water (水) with one drop (丶) stuck fast at its top corner: a drop that has stopped moving because it has frozen solid. Ice (icicle, hail, freeze).

k:賛.mnemonic: Two husbands, husband (夫) beside husband (夫), look over a shellfish (貝) at the market, nod together and each put a thumb up. Approve (praise, assist, agree with).
k:賛.hint: Two husbands nodding over a shell.

k:奴.mnemonic: A woman (女) points across the room: 'And that one also (又), what's-his-name, the fellow who is always hanging around.' Guy (slave, manservant, fellow).

k:筋.mnemonic: Lift bamboo (竹) poles every day for a month (月) and power (力) builds in your arms: cords as stringy and tough as the bamboo itself. Muscle (sinew, tendon, fiber).
k:筋.hint: A month of lifting bamboo poles.

k:踏.mnemonic: On a hot day (日) you put one leg (足) down in the water (水) of the stream, then the other, stamping on the stones as you cross. Step (trample, carry through).

k:仰.mnemonic: A leader (亻) on a balcony holds up the stamp (卩) of office, and everyone in the square below tilts their head right back to see it. Face-up (look up, depend, respect).

k:衝.mnemonic: Yesterday (昨) two carts tried to go (行) through the one narrow crossroads of the hometown (里) at the same moment, and met in the middle with a crash. Collide (brunt, highway, thrust).

k:剤.mnemonic: The chemist trims the pill with a knife (刂) until the amount is adjusted (斉) exactly for the patient: half for a child, a whole one for an adult. Dose (medicine, drug).
k:剤.hint: Chemist trimming a pill to size.

k:襲.mnemonic: For a month (月) the raiders stand (立) hidden on the ridge. Then, each in a dark garment (衣), they pour down upon the sleeping fort. Advance on (attack, succeed to, heap).
k:襲.hint: Dark raiders pouring off the ridge.

k:迫.mnemonic: A rider on a white (白) horse closes in behind you on the path (辶), shouting 'Faster, faster!' until you break into a run. Urge (force, imminent, spur on).
k:迫.hint: White horse closing in behind you.

k:腕.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀) a clerk works every evening (夕) for a month (月), thumping the stamp (卩) on papers until one limb is twice as strong as the other. Arm (ability, talent, skill).
k:腕.hint: A month of thumping the stamp.

k:詳.mnemonic: Ask the shepherd about one sheep (羊) and he will say (言) everything: its age, its mother, the day it limped. Nothing is left out. Detailed (full, minute, accurate).
k:詳.hint: Shepherd tells all about one animal.

k:脳.mnemonic: Inside the pit (凵) of the skull, ideas sparkle (⺌) like sparks. Leave a puzzle in there for a month (月) and the answer lights up by itself. Brain (memory).

k:祝.mnemonic: Elder brother (兄) kneels at the altar (礻) on his wedding day while the whole family cheers and pours the wine. Celebrate (congratulate).
k:祝.hint: Brother's wedding day at the altar.

k:稲.mnemonic: Stalks so heavy with grain (禾) that they bend (曲) low over the paddy, and a hand like a claw (爪) gathers a bunch to cut. Rice plant.
k:稲.hint: Heavy stalks bowing over the paddy.
